title: "Z2" - Upgraded Homemade Silicon Chips
summary: Sam Zeloof shows the upgraded second iteration of his homemade silicon integrated circuit fabrication process, producing chips with around a thousand transistors in his garage. It is a short overview of what the home fab can now do.
why: HN uses it as the go-to proof that small-scale, hobbyist chip fabrication is real, and as an entry point to the topic.

quote.text: It's fantastic and I highly recommend watching it.
